## Documented parameters

### `lldModularDrawer`

| Param | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `add_account` | true | Use the modular drawer in the add-account flow. |
| `live_app` | true | Use the modular drawer when triggered from a Live App. |
| `live_apps_allowlist` | [] | Live App manifest ids explicitly allowed to use the modular drawer. |
| `live_apps_blocklist` | [] | Live App manifest ids explicitly blocked from the modular drawer. |
| `receive_flow` | true | Use the modular drawer in the receive flow. |
| `send_flow` | true | Use the modular drawer in the send flow. |
| `enableModularization` | false | Master switch for the modularization refactor behind the drawer. |
| `searchDebounceTime` | 500 | Debounce in ms applied to the drawer's asset search input. |
| `backendEnvironment` | "PROD" | Which backend environment the drawer queries (e.g. "PROD"). |
| `enableDialogDesktop` | false | Render the drawer as a desktop dialog instead of a side drawer. |

### `llmModularDrawer`

| Param | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `add_account` | true | Use the modular drawer in the add-account flow. |
| `live_app` | true | Use the modular drawer when triggered from a Live App. |

| `receive_flow` | true | Use the modular drawer in the receive flow. |
| `send_flow` | true | Use the modular drawer in the send flow. |
| `enableModularization` | false | Master switch for the modularization refactor behind the drawer. |
| `searchDebounceTime` | 500 | Debounce in ms applied to the drawer's asset search input. |
| `backendEnvironment` | "PROD" | Which backend environment the drawer queries (e.g. "PROD"). |

### `lwdWallet40`

| Param | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tour` | true | Shows the Wallet 4.0 product tour (Q1 wave). |
| `q2Tour` | false | Shows the Q2 variant of the product tour (Q2 wave). |
| `lazyOnboarding` | true | Enables the lazy onboarding flow. |
| `assetSection` | false | Enables the redesigned asset section on the portfolio screen. |
| `operationsList` | false | Enables the redesigned operations (transactions) list. |
| `brazePlacement` | true | Enables Braze content placements within the W40 layout. |
| `aggregatedAssets` | false | Aggregates balances of the same asset across accounts. |
| `myWallet` | false | Enables the 'My Wallet' entry point/section. |
| `pnl` | false | Shows portfolio profit & loss (PnL). |
| `assetDiscoverability` | false | Enables asset-discoverability entry points. |
| `earnUpselling` | false | Shows Earn upsell surfaces within the wallet. |
| `earnSimulator` | false | Enables the Earn rewards simulator. |
